_comment: Mossborn Hydra 2026-10-22 (a Landfall SCREENING candidate): the searched land-drop timing for a
counter-DOUBLING landfall watcher. T3 on the play, three untapped Forests, hand Mossborn Hydra +
two Forests, opponent at 4, resumed at main 1. CAST THE HYDRA FIRST (it enters with one +1/+1
counter), THEN play the Forest: its landfall doubles it to 2; T4's Forest doubles it to 4 and the
Hydra (no longer sick) swings for exactly 4 -- the only T4 win. Land-first casts a 1/1 that is a
2/2 on T4 (2 damage) and needs T5. So T4 needs the land-after plan to be enumerated (the card is a
landfall watcher: CardDefinition::landfall_watcher via landfall_double_self_counters), the
enters-with counter (enters_with_plus_counters) to be on the body, and the doubling to fire from
the land drop (PlayLandFromHand -> OnLandEntered) in both worlds.
Filler = Swords to Plowshares: a dead draw on a mono-Forest board.
